user_query: trass stories about the international launch within the last 3 months

intent.goal: find stories related to the international launch

generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.title,
u.created_time,
u.database_name,
g.message_content,
g.subject,
g.body_snippet
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
LEFT JOIN generic_content gc ON u.page_id = gc.page_id
WHERE u.workspace = 'trass' 
AND u.database_name IN ('stories', 'journal', 'gmail', 'discord', 'tg')
AND u.created_time >= date('now', '-3 months')
AND (
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%international%' OR LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%international%' OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%international%' OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%launch%'  
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%international%' OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(gc.metadata) LIKE '%international%' OR LOWER(gc.metadata) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(gc.title) LIKE '%international%' OR LOWER(gc.title) LIKE '%launch%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 5000;
